newsitem.title: USA: Premier says to acquire Citizens Gwinnett.
newsitem.headline: Premier says to acquire Citizens Gwinnett.

text.p: Premier Bancshares Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire single bank holding company Citizens Gwinnett Bankshares Inc.

Premier said it agreed to issue between 2.1 million and 2.3 million common shares in exchange for all the outstanding common shares of Citizens Gwinnett. The specific number will be determined and fixed prior to the regulatory filing of the acquisition, Premier said.
Based on 2.2 million shares, which is the mid-point of the specified range, and Monday's closing price of Premier stock, the total value of the deal would be about $35 million.
The deal is expected to close before the end of the year, and will make Premier a bank with assets in excess of $700 million.
